claimText: All aeronautical ground lights shall be operated continuously during the hours of darkness or during the time the centre of the sun’s disc is more than 6 degrees below the horizon, whichever requires the longer period of operation, unless otherwise provided hereafter or otherwise required for the control of air traffic.
rationale: Direct authoritative requirement for the default operational state of all aeronautical ground lights based on solar position and darkness.
